services_shape: fertility clinic: consults and monitoring with a named doctor or the next open clinician; procedure days (an IUI, an egg retrieval or an embryo transfer) with the procedure team and a companion; a home nurse visit for injection teaching; a semen analysis dropped off in a private room at the clinic; a video consult counts as at the clinic
questions_before_times: the kind of visit (new consult, monitoring, procedure day, injection teaching at home)
whether it's a video consult (counts as at the clinic)
a health plan or self-pay (only the plan's name here)
for a procedure day: the adult who will drive the patient home, named on the booking
for a home visit: the town and whether the patient can come to the door
safety_stop: heavy bleeding, severe belly or pelvic pain, dizziness or fainting, trouble breathing, or chest pain, after a procedure or a stimulation medicine
first_steps: A private history for a new patient
license: a state physician license for each reproductive doctor, and the clinic's license where the state requires one; a nurse's license for injection teaching; the lab's certificate for any semen analysis the state names; the clinic's registration where the state's rules require it
staff_skills: reproductive medicine, monitoring, IUI and retrieval support, embryology, semen analysis, injection teaching, counseling referral, Spanish
messages_never: the history, the names of tests or procedures, cycle or pregnancy details, results, medicines, ID numbers and plan details never go in a text: only the secure page; texts say only the clinic's name, the day, the time and the place
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
